modalities.evidence: Participants watched short films during fMRI

output.population: Human participants (n=43) with measures of autism traits, empathy traits and theory of mind, plus depression, anxiety and alexithymia co-morbidities
output.summary: Naturalistic fMRI dataset in which participants watched short films paired with soundtracks varying in musical properties while focusing on characters' mental states, supporting study of theory-of-mind encoding and autism-related traits.
